Daniel — joining from SRE. Quick status update from our side after pulling traces and heap profiles:

What we see:
- Elevated KV cache miss rates on model A (long-context) starting at 16:07 PT, coincident with a small traffic spike from Rybak's batch jobs.
- Several inference containers reported transient OOMs; autoscaler added pods but warm-up latency increased tail.
- Error types: 502/504 timeout up to 6s and several context-OOMs.

Immediate mitigations applied (16:18 PT):
1) Traffic shift: routed 30% of checkout traffic to a smaller, cached variant (model-A-lite) with shorter context and pre-warmed pool.
2) Reduced concurrency on long-context workers to limit OOMs and prioritize requests for checkout routes.
3) Enabled aggressive prefix KV caching for repeated sessions.

Early result (16:32 PT): tail latency reduced from ~8.7s median 95th to ~2.6s; error rate down from 8% to 2.1% on sampled traffic. We'll continue incremental rollout while watching error rates.

Next steps:
- If metrics remain stable for 20m, increase redirected traffic to 60%.
- Karthik to present a fallback quantized variant if we see memory pressure reappear.
- Postmortem owners: Marissa (ops timeline), Karthik (runtime/root cause), Jonas (customer impact/credits).

Attachments: short telemetry snapshot uploaded to OPS-7214 and a sanitized error sample (rybak_error_sampling_0615.log).

Zoom remains open: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210

— Marissa
